buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BUYER ADDED ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) Procurement of Library Books for Govt. Higher Secondary School, Arreh 1. Statutory & Mandatory Vendor Credentials The participating bidder must upload clear, valid scanned copies of the following mandatory documents al ong with their bid: - PAN Card: Copy of the Permanent Account Number card of the firm, proprietor, or authorized agency. - GST Registration: Valid Goods and Services Tax (GST) registration certificate under the relevant jurisdicti on. - Income Tax Returns (ITR): Copies of ITRs for the preceding financial year. 2. Scope of Supply & Specifications - Multi-Publisher Requirement: The vendor must be capable of fulfilling a diverse multi-publisher book list ( covering academic reference, literature, general knowledge, and library reading materials) as per the spec ifications provided in the bid's Excel sheet. - Latest Revised Editions: All supplied books must be the latest revised, current editions. Old stock, pirated editions, damaged bindings, or photocopied pages will be strictly rejected. - All-Inclusive Pricing: Quoted rates must be net and inclusive of all packing, forwarding, freight, transit ins urance, and doorstep delivery charges up to Govt. Higher Secondary School, Arreh. 3. Short-Supply & Out-of-Print (OOP) Protocol - Fulfillment Target: The successful L1 bidder is expected to supply a minimum of 75% to 80% of the total o rdered book titles. - Publisher Certification for Missing Titles: If any specific title is unavailable or out of print, the vendor must

submit an official, verifiable Out-of-Print Certificate or non-availability letter issued directly by the publishe r/distributor. 4. Physical Verification & Acceptance - Committee Inspection: Delivered books will be subjected to physical inspection and verification by the sc hool's 6-Member Purchase Committee. - Replacement of Defective Items: Any sub-standard, torn, or misprinted books identified during inspection must be replaced by the vendor within 7 working days at their own expense before final stock entry and bi ll clearance. 5. Payment Terms - Post-Verification Disbursement: 100% payment shall be released strictly after successful physical verifica tion, entry into the official school stock register, and completion of billing formalities. No advance payment is admissible under financial rules. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
